summary: Iteration 64 - Bug verification: Guided script repetition issue CONFIRMED. The /api/content/expand-script endpoint produces highly repetitive content with step phrases repeated 6-16 times and template stems repeated 2-4 times each. Duplicate paragraphs also found at end of scripts. Timer/autoplay functionality verified working (no regression).

critical.issue: Step phrases repeated excessively (6-16x per script). Example: 'Find a comfortable seated position' appears 16x in Pendulation script
Template stems repeated 2-4x each: 'Bring your attention to', 'Let your next point of focus be', 'Center this phase around', etc.
Duplicate paragraphs at end of script (welcome paragraphs appear 2x)
Awkward sentence construction: 'Bring your attention to Find a comfortable seated position. Find a comfortable seated position Carry this thread...'

action_items: CRITICAL: Refactor _build_fallback_paragraphs() in /app/backend/routers/content.py to avoid cycling through same step phrases repeatedly
Remove duplicate paragraph insertion at end of script (lines 391-396 in content.py append fallback paragraphs that may duplicate)
Improve sentence construction to avoid verbatim step insertion like 'Bring your attention to [step text]'
Consider using step phrases only once or twice, then paraphrasing or expanding on them
Add deduplication logic that checks for repeated sentence stems, not just exact paragraph matches
Frontend buildNarrationPlan() in GuidedPracticeOverlay.jsx has similar issues - sync fixes
critical_code_review_comments: Backend _build_fallback_paragraphs() uses index % len(array) cycling which causes same phrases to repeat every N paragraphs
step_focuses array is cycled through repeatedly: step_focuses[index % len(step_focuses)] causes same steps to appear 10+ times
focus_leads, continuity_leads, integration_leads arrays are too small (4-5 items) causing rapid cycling
_dedupe_paragraphs() only removes consecutive duplicates, not repeated content throughout script
Lines 391-396 append fallback_paragraphs to selected_paragraphs which can duplicate welcome paragraphs

success_rate.backend: 100% (endpoint returns 200, but content quality is poor)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug confirmed: expand-script produces repetitive content. Main agent needs to refactor _build_fallback_paragraphs() to avoid cycling through same phrases. Timer/autoplay works correctly. Test file created at /app/backend/tests/test_expand_script_repetition.py for regression testing.

no_regression_verified.timer_countdown: PASS - Timer counts down correctly (6:55 after 5 seconds)
no_regression_verified.mute_button: PASS - Mute button present and functional

rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: The _build_fallback_paragraphs() function in /app/backend/routers/content.py uses modulo cycling (index % len(array)) to select phrases from small arrays (4-8 items). When generating 15-30 paragraphs for a 7-15 minute script, the same phrases cycle through 3-4 times. Additionally, step_focuses array contains the raw step text which gets inserted verbatim multiple times.
reproduction_steps: 2. Provide 3-5 steps in the steps array
4. Observe that step phrases appear 10+ times in output
mitigation: 1. Expand template arrays to 15-20 unique phrases each
2. Use step phrases only once, then paraphrase or expand
3. Add sentence-level deduplication that checks for repeated stems
4. Remove the fallback paragraph appending logic that causes duplicates
5. Consider using AI expansion more aggressively when available
